message.author: Mara Lindqvist
message.text: Customers on the annual plan see last month's invoice PDF when they open this month's from the email link. Three reports today, all annual plan, all opened from the mail.

thread.author: Eli Ng
thread.text: The email link carries the invoice id; the PDF cache key is the customer id only. Annual plan customers are the ones with two invoices in the window.

thread.author: Mara Lindqvist
thread.text: @Claude tag this for triage — wrong invoice shown is a billing-trust issue.
